spans.s:
r. 2nd cl. (द्योति)
1 To advance towards or against, to assail.
2 To advance before or in front of, to approach.

m. (द्युः)
A name of AGNI or fire.
n. (द्यु)
1 A day.
2 Heaven, sky, æther.
2 Heaven, paradise.
E.
द्यु to go to or towards, affix क्विप्.

m. (-कः)
An owl.

m. (-रिः)
A crow.

m. (-गः)
A bird.
E.
द्यु, and ग who goes.

m. (-णः)
A given term of days, as a month, &c.
E.
द्यु, and गण a number.

r. 1st cl. (द्योतते)
To shine.

mn. (-तः-तं)
Gaming, playing with dice, or any thing not possessing life.
E.
दिव to play, क्त aff.

m. (द्युत्)
A ray of light.
E.
द्युत to shine, affix क्विप्.

Light.
2

Beauty or splendour.
3 A ray of light.
4 Stimulating, exciting.
E.
द्युत to shine, affix कि.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Shining, bright.
2 Handsome.
m. (-रः)
The polar star, or in mythology, the divine sage DHRUVA.
E.
द्युति light, and कर who makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Enlightened, illuminated, &c.
E.
द्युत to shine, affix क्त; also with the vowel changed द्योतित.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Resplendent, bright.
E.
द्युति, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-ला)
A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.)
E.
द्युति beauty, and ला to possess, affix ड and टाप्.

m. (-सः)
1 Heavenly abode, heaven.
2 A deity.
E.
द्यु, and निवास abiding.

m. (-सी)
1 A deity.
2 A pious person.
E.
द्यु, and निवासिन् who abides.

n. (-शं)
Day and night.
E.
द्यु a day, निशा night.

m. (-तिः)
1 The sun.
2 A name of INDRA.
E.
द्यु a day or paradise, and पति ruler.

m. (-णिः)
The sun.
E.
द्यु a day, and मणि a gem.

f. (-यी)
The daughter of VIŚVAKARMA, and wife of the sun.
E.
द्यु a day, and मयट् affix of identity.

n. (-म्नं)
1 Wealth, property, substance.
2 Strength, power.
E.
द्यु day, म्ना to remember or regard, affix क.

m. (-वा)
1 The sun.
2 Heaven.
E.
द्यु to go, (through the heavens,) Uṇādi affix कनिन्.

m. (-षद् or षत्)
1 A god, a deity.
2 A planet.
E.
द्यु heaven, षद to go, affix क्विप्; it is also written द्युषद्.

m. (-रः)
A gambler.
E.
द्यूत, and कर who practices.

m. (-रः)
1 The keeper of a gaming house.
2 A gambler.
E.
द्यूत gaming, and कार who practices; also with कन् added, द्यूतकारक.

m. (-कृत्)
A gambler.
E.
द्यूत, and कृत् who practices: see the last.

f. (-मा)
The day of full moon in the month Kārttika, (October-November,) the night of which is spent in games of chance, in honour of the goddess of fortune, LAKṢMĪ.
E.
द्यूत gaming, and पूर्णिमा day of full moon; also with अण् pleonastic affix added, and ङीष् fem. affix द्यूतपौर्णिमी, f. (-मी)

f. (-पत्)
The first day of the moon's increase in Kartik, when BĀLĪ is to be venerated.
E.
द्यूत, and प्रतिपद् the first lunation.

n. (-जं)
A Cowri, a small shell used as a coin in most parts of India.
E.
द्यत gaming, and वीज seed.

m. (-त्तिः)
A gambler.
E.
द्यूत, and वृत्ति subsistence.

f. (-भा)
A gaming house or assembly.
E.
द्यूत, and सभा an assembly.

m. (-री)
The keeper of a gaming house.
E.
द्यूत, and अधिकारिन् who superintends.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Playing, sportive.
n. (-नं)
The seventh sign of the zodiac, reckoning^1 from that which the sun enters.
E.
दिव to play, &c. affix क्त.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.
